mapper.select: select count(1) from ticket_executions where ticket_id = #{ticketId} and result = 'UNCERTAIN' and verification_status is null
mapper.update: update ticket_executions set result = #{result}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, response_payload = #{responsePayload}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and result = 'PENDING'

update ticket_executions set verification_status = #{verificationStatus}, verified_by = #{verifiedBy}, verified_at = #{verifiedAt}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and result = 'UNCERTAIN' and verification_status is null
